trailhead.label: Public car park at the Gasthaus Eggerhof, bus 268 terminus Eggerhof (official start)

cautions: Forest roads and tracks used by forestry and farm vehicles.
A barrier across the track just after the car park.
A short stretch of narrower path near km 3.7–4.0.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Public car park at the Gasthaus Eggerhof: Parcheggio pubblico al Gasthaus Eggerhof, capolinea Eggerhof dell'autobus 268 (partenza ufficiale)
textIt.Forest roads and tracks used by forestry: Strade forestali e piste usate da mezzi forestali e agricoli.
textIt.A barrier across the track just after th: Una sbarra sulla strada subito dopo il parcheggio.
textIt.A short stretch of narrower path near km: Un breve tratto di sentiero più stretto verso il km 3,7–4,0.
